scope: binary phase of the read path only; sign-on text, banner, password, ROM id and all writes, uploads and 0A/10 frames removed
payload: synthetic: every pbx frame is the kxtd1232-sim reply for synthetic_db() and PLACEHOLDER_ROM_ID, checksum recomputed over the synthetic bytes; host frames are the read plan headers
t_ms: milliseconds since the first binary frame, rounded
